TriggerTiming.doc: When the trigger fires relative to the row write. INSTEAD OF is permitted only on views (compiler-enforced; parser admits it on any target). The published SQLite grammar treats absence of this keyword as an implicit BEFORE; this parser requires the keyword (see create-trigger-stmt master.md pin 2).

Before.doc: BEFORE — fire before the row is written; body may abort the write via RAISE.

After.doc: AFTER — fire after the row is written; the row's effect is visible to the body.

InsteadOf.doc: INSTEAD OF — replace the operation entirely. Only valid on views; compiler enforces.

TriggerEvent.doc: Which DML operation activates the trigger. UpdateOf carries an optional column-restriction list — the trigger fires only when at least one named column appears in the UPDATE's SET list. An empty list means 'any column' (plain UPDATE without OF).

UpdateOf.doc: UPDATE event, optionally restricted to a column list. columns=[] means 'any column'.

TriggerBodyStmt.doc: One statement in a trigger body. Each case wraps the corresponding per-statement AST as parsed by its owning parser leaf. The compiler dispatches on this discriminator when lowering the trigger body into VDBE program fragments.

Select.doc: SELECT body statement (executed for side-effects via RAISE or value-discard).

CreateTriggerStmt.doc: Parsed CREATE TRIGGER statement. Captures every syntactic element of the published grammar admitted in scope: temp-flag, if-not-exists, name, timing, event, target table, for_each_row flag, optional WHEN predicate, and the body statement list. Schema-qualified names (`main.tr`, `main.t`) are deferred. Trigger semantics (OLD/NEW availability per event, INSTEAD-OF-only-on-views, recursion control) are NOT enforced here — that lives in /parts/compiler/parts/triggers.

CreateTriggerParseOk.doc: Successful parse output: the CreateTriggerStmt plus the index of the next un-consumed token (positioned AFTER the closing END, BEFORE any outer ';' / Eof).

parse_create_trigger.doc: Parse a CREATE TRIGGER statement starting at tokens[start]. Token at start MUST be KwCreate. Delegates the WHEN predicate to parse_expr and each body statement to its owning parser leaf (parse_insert / parse_update / parse_delete / parse_select). Rejects schema-qualified names, body statements outside the INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/SELECT set, and (for clarity) implicit-BEFORE timing — each with `deferred: <construct>` or a precise error message per the master.md pins.
